tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Page ground. Lay the diamond checker over it with `sky-check`.

tokens.name: sky-check
tokens.usage: The checker squares on `sky`, and on prize-card art. Decoration only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, list rows, modals, and an input that has focus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs at rest, meter and switch tracks, idle day cells, a card's footer strip.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative borders and the lip under panels and rows. Never the only thing marking a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons, tiles): 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-sunken`. The logo's periwinkle outline.

tokens.name: line-lip
tokens.usage: The 4px lip under secondary buttons, icon buttons and menu tiles.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings, on `sky`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and every `*-soft` fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: help lines, labels, metadata. On `sky`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, future steps. On `surface` and `surface-sunken` only.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: The switch knob.

tokens.name: gloss
tokens.usage: The 2px highlight along the top inside edge of raised things (inset shadow).

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: The 2px shadow along the top inside edge of sunken things (inset shadow).

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The deep-navy plate behind meters, stat chips and the bottom nav.

tokens.name: frame-track
tokens.usage: Empty track inside a meter, dividers on `frame`.

tokens.name: frame-lip
tokens.usage: Lip under `frame` plates.

tokens.name: frame-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and idle icons on `frame`.

tokens.name: on-frame
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on `frame`.

tokens.name: logo-line
tokens.usage: The logo's navy outline. Use for the logo-style display text stroke only.

tokens.name: logo-fill
tokens.usage: The bottom of the logo letters' fill. Use for the logo-style display text and large brand blocks.

tokens.name: royal-hi
tokens.usage: Top of a royal fill (gradient start).

tokens.name: royal
tokens.usage: Primary brand fill: royal buttons, the current menu tile, ribbons, checked boxes.

tokens.name: royal-line
tokens.usage: Border of a royal fill.

tokens.name: royal-lip
tokens.usage: Lip under a royal fill.

tokens.name: on-royal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a royal fill (`royal-hi` to `royal`).

tokens.name: royal-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-blue text, links and icons on `sky`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `royal-soft`.

tokens.name: royal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill: the in-review badge, selected rows, avatar fallbacks.

tokens.name: royal-glow
tokens.usage: The soft halo around a focused input and today's day cell.

tokens.name: gold-hi
tokens.usage: Top of a gold fill.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one main action per screen, the chosen goal, stars, the current step. The logo's star.

tokens.name: gold-line
tokens.usage: Border of a gold fill; the ring on a ready prize.

tokens.name: gold-lip
tokens.usage: Lip under a gold fill; the drop under stars.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill (`gold-hi` to `gold`).

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold text on `surface` and `gold-soft` (the changes-needed badge).

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill: changes-needed badge, your own leaderboard row, the halo on the current step.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: The logo's halo. Decoration and streak fire icons; not for text.

tokens.name: copper-ink
tokens.usage: Copper text on `surface`, `cream` and `gold-soft` (streak counts).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The halo's light. A built day cell; warm callouts.

tokens.name: bronze-hi
tokens.usage: Top of the third-place medal.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Third-place medal; the streak key on a stat chip.

tokens.name: on-bronze
tokens.usage: Text on `bronze-hi` to `bronze`.

tokens.name: silver-hi
tokens.usage: Top of the second-place medal.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Second-place medal.

tokens.name: on-silver
tokens.usage: Text on `silver-hi` to `silver`.

tokens.name: mint-hi
tokens.usage: Top of a mint fill.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Done and approved: finished steps, checked-off ship checks, a switch that is on, approved hours.

tokens.name: mint-line
tokens.usage: Border of a mint fill.

tokens.name: mint-lip
tokens.usage: Lip under a mint fill.

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mint fill.

tokens.name: mint-ink
tokens.usage: Mint text on `surface` and `mint-soft` (approved badge, rank gains).

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind `mint-ink`.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The bright end of the hours meter's fill. Decoration only.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Errors and blocking ship checks: the field border and the mark. Always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: coral-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on `surface` and `coral-soft`.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind `coral-ink`: a field with an error, a failing check's mark.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Notification dots and digital prizes. The tagline purple.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text on a `violet` fill (the count in a notification dot).

tokens.name: violet-ink
tokens.usage: Violet text on `surface` and `violet-soft`; the tagline outline style.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind `violet-ink`; the deadline day cell.

families.body: "Nunito", ui-rounded, "Arial Rounded MT Bold", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Rubik, heavy and leaning like the logo. Italic for anything that shouts; upright for card headings.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Continue a game you stopped working on
styles.usage: The landing headline only, one per page. Drop to `display` under 600px wide.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Hours and counts that are the point of a card. Always with tabular numerals.

styles.name: number-sm
styles.usage: Numbers in stat chips, ribbons and leaderboard rows.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Nunito, rounded and friendly. Never lighter than 600: thin text looks wrong next to the chunky shapes.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Keep building the game you made in the jame gam. Every hour you log gets you closer to a prize.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero or page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hours you log in Hackatime from the day Save Point starts count toward your prize.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, list item titles, emphasis.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: A public link where anyone can read your game's code.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and eyebrows, set in uppercase with CSS.

spacing.note: 4px base. Lay siblings out with gap, not margins.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; gaps inside chips and tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related controls in a row; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding; ribbon inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; grid gap; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; panel top padding under a ribbon.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Above and below the landing hero.

radius.note: Everything is rounded. Nothing in Save Point has a square corner.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, meter bars, day cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menu tiles, FAQ rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels and modals.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: badges, chips, toasts, the bottom nav, leaderboard rows, avatars.

shadow.note: Depth is a solid lip in the fill's own darker shade, plus a soft float. Never a black outline.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: The float under panels, toasts and modals, added to their lip.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 3px gap in the ground colour, then 3px of solid navy (gold in dark). Add it to the control's own shadows.

size.note: Control heights, icon sizes and page widths.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small button and icon button height.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and icon button height. The touch target floor on phones.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The main call to action on a screen.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and help lines.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, rows and the nav.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons on menu tiles.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Widest a page's content gets.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Widest a block of running text gets.

tokens.name: slant
tokens.usage: The lean of ribbons, meters and player plates (`skewX`), from the logo's italic letters. Counter-skew the text inside.

tokens.name: lip-depth
tokens.usage: Height of the solid lip under raised things.

tokens.name: press-depth
tokens.usage: How far a raised thing moves down when pressed; its lip shrinks by the same amount.
